channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Germany to acquire MQ-9B SeaGuardian drones
item.description: Germany has agreed to procure eight MQ-9B SeaGuardian remotely piloted aircraft through the NATO Support and Procurement Agency. The post Germany to acquire MQ-9B SeaGuardian drones first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: CDS says Greenland within NATO area of responsibility
item.description: The Chief of the Defence Staff told MPs that Greenland sits within NATO’s area of responsibility, as ministers face growing scrutiny over stretched UK military capacity. The post CDS says Greenland within NATO area of responsibility first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence chief warns UK lacks funds for current plans
item.description: The Ministry of Defence is forecasting a funding gap against current plans by the end of the financial year, despite remaining within its spending limits to date, the Chief of the Defence Staff has told MPs. The post Defence chief warns UK lacks funds for current plans first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: HII shifts UK role toward autonomy and in-country support
item.description: HII has outlined plans to expand UK-based unmanned systems work, including jobs growth, in-country support and future autonomy activity. The post HII shifts UK role toward autonomy and in-country support first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Crombie remains key to naval ops but no details given
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has declined to provide details on how Defence Munitions Crombie is being used by the Royal Navy, citing operational security while confirming the site remains a key enabler for operations in the North Sea, High North and Euro-Atlantic. The post Crombie remains key to naval ops but no details given first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Only PM controls UK nuclear weapons, says minister
item.description: The government has said that closer nuclear cooperation with France under the Northwood Declaration does not affect the United Kingdom’s independent nuclear deterrent. The post Only PM controls UK nuclear weapons, says minister first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Immigration raids hit record levels across UK and Scotland
item.description: Immigration Enforcement activity has reached its highest level on record, with the Home Office reporting sharp increases in raids and arrests targeting illegal working across the UK, including a significant rise in operations in Scotland. The post Immigration raids hit record levels across UK and Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New officer takes command of the Red Arrows
item.description: Wing Commander Sasha Nash has taken command of the Royal Air Force Aerobatic Team, becoming the new Officer Commanding of the Red Arrows as the display unit prepares for the 2026 season. The post New officer takes command of the Red Arrows first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New tugboats for Faslane will not be built in China
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has now confirmed that vessels procured under the Defence Maritime Services programme, including tugs for Faslane, will not be built in China. The post New tugboats for Faslane will not be built in China first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK and Poland agree deeper missile defence cooperation
item.description: The UK and Poland have agreed to deepen cooperation on air and missile defence and expand helicopter training links, as both countries look to strengthen their ability to counter airborne threats. The post UK and Poland agree deeper missile defence cooperation first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
